## Role in the pipeline

| | |
|---|---|
| **Thesis section** | 3.2 analysis sample (Table 2), 3.3 variable definitions |
| **Input** | `firmyear_panel.rds` (file 3), `sdc_counts.rds` (file 1), `link_counts.rds` (file 3) |
| **Output** | `analysis_sample.rds` (the regression sample), `table2_sample_construction.csv`, `table_winsorisation.csv` |
| **Previous / next file** | `03_linking_and_distance.qmd` / `05_descriptives.qmd` |

The order of the steps follows the thesis:

1. Alliance counts: categories, related/unrelated, governance split, three-year window
2. Dependent variable: forward revenue growth (t to t+3, and t to t+1 for robustness)
3. Analysis sample (all filters), i.e. Table 2
4. Winsorisation within the analysis sample


```{r}
#| label: setup
source("00_config.R")
fp <- readRDS(file.path(path, "firmyear_panel.rds"))
dim(fp)
```

## 1. Alliance counts

```{r}
#| label: counts
# Totals per distance category (equity + non-equity), for H1 (and A1)
for (k in cats) fp[, (k) := get(paste0(k, "_eq")) + get(paste0(k, "_ne"))]

# Related (D0-D3) vs unrelated (D4), also split by governance (A2);
# the five categories split by governance are used for H2;
# non-equity alliances (n_ca) = all alliances that are not equity-based
# (n_jv = equity-based: joint venture flag or equity-transfer technique)
fp[, `:=`(n_rel      = d0_same4 + d1_same3 + d2_same2 + d3_same_division,
          n_unrel    = d4_diff_division,
          n_rel_eq   = d0_same4_eq + d1_same3_eq + d2_same2_eq + d3_same_division_eq,
          n_rel_ne   = d0_same4_ne + d1_same3_ne + d2_same2_ne + d3_same_division_ne,
          n_unrel_eq = d4_diff_division_eq,
          n_unrel_ne = d4_diff_division_ne,
          n_ca       = n_alliances - n_jv)]
```

### Alliance windows

The main alliance variable counts alliances formed in years t-2 to t
(three-year window, suffix `_3y`). The other windows (2, 4, 5 years) are only
needed for the sensitivity check R5 and use the five category totals.
Missing earlier years count as zero.

```{r}
#| label: windows
# Sum of a variable over the years t, t-1, ..., t-(w-1) within firm
add_window <- function(dt, vars, w, suffix) {
  for (v in vars) {
    out <- as.numeric(dt[[v]])
    for (l in seq_len(w - 1)) {
      src    <- dt[, .(gvkey, fyear = fyear + l, val = get(v))]
      lagged <- src[dt[, .(gvkey, fyear)], on = .(gvkey, fyear), val]
      out    <- out + fcoalesce(as.numeric(lagged), 0)
    }
    dt[, (paste0(v, suffix)) := out]
  }
}

cnt_3y <- c("n_alliances", "n_jv", "n_ca", cats,
            "n_rel", "n_unrel", "n_rel_eq", "n_rel_ne", "n_unrel_eq", "n_unrel_ne",
            paste0(rep(cats, each = 2), c("_eq", "_ne")))

setorder(fp, gvkey, fyear)
add_window(fp, cnt_3y, 3, "_3y")                                # main specification
for (w in c(2, 4, 5)) add_window(fp, cats, w, paste0("_w", w))  # check R5
```

## 2. Dependent variable: forward revenue growth

Alliances in the window ending in t are followed by growth **after** t:

* **Main model:** annualised growth from t to t+3 (equation 1 in the thesis),
  `(Revenue[t+3] / Revenue[t])^(1/3) - 1`, in the firm's reporting currency
* **Robustness R4:** growth from t to t+1

Both are kept raw here (`growth_f3`, `growth_f1`) and winsorised in step 4.

```{r}
#| label: forward-growth
fp[, `:=`(fyear1 = fyear + 1L, fyear3 = fyear + 3L)]

# 1 year: the (raw) one-year growth of the following year
fp[fp, on = .(gvkey, fyear1 = fyear), growth_f1 := i.growth]

# 3 years: revenue in t+3 compared to t, annualised
fp[fp, on = .(gvkey, fyear3 = fyear), `:=`(revt_f3 = i.revt, curcd_f3 = i.curcd)]
fp[, growth_f3 := fifelse(revt > 0 & revt_f3 > 0 & curcd == curcd_f3,
                          (revt_f3 / revt)^(1/3) - 1, NA_real_)]

summary(fp$growth_f3)   # raw: extreme maximum -> reason for winsorising
```

## 3. Analysis sample (Table 2)

Filters, in this order:

1. no financial firms (SIC 60-69): revenues and balance sheets not comparable
2. no utilities (SIC 49): regulated; and no unclassifiable firms (SIC 99) or
   firms without any historical SIC (they remain eligible as alliance **partners**)
3. lagged revenue of at least USD 10 million (t-1), because growth rates of very
   small firms are volatile
4. growth from t to t+3 and all controls available

```{r}
#| label: sample
min_rev <- 10   # USD million

n <- c("All Compustat firm-years" = nrow(fp))

d <- fp[!(financial %in% TRUE)]
n["Excl. financial firms"] <- nrow(d)

d <- d[!is.na(sic2) & !(as.integer(as.character(sic2)) %in% c(49, 99))]
n["Excl. utilities, unclassifiable, no historical SIC"] <- nrow(d)

d <- d[revt_usd_lag >= min_rev]
n["Revenue >= USD 10m in t-1"] <- nrow(d)

d <- d[!is.na(growth_f3) & !is.na(ln_at_usd) & !is.na(roa) &
         !is.na(leverage) & !is.na(growth_l1)]
n["Growth t to t+3 and controls available"] <- nrow(d)

sample_steps <- data.table(step = names(n), firm_years = as.integer(n))
sample_steps[, removed := shift(firm_years) - firm_years]
sample_steps[, removed_pct := round(100 * removed / shift(firm_years), 1)]
knitr::kable(sample_steps, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Construction of the analysis sample (firm-years)")

cat("Firms:", uniqueN(d$gvkey), " | Years:", min(d$fyear), "-", max(d$fyear), "\n")
cat("Alliances in sample:", sum(d$n_alliances),
    " | Firm-years with >= 1 alliance (year t):", d[n_alliances > 0, .N], "\n")
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Documented decisions behind the sample

* **SIC:** historical `sich` is available for 86.5% of firm-years, 10.7% can be filled
  from another year of the same firm, 2.8% have no `sich` in any year and drop out.
  Fill distance: 1-2 years 39%, 3-5 years 32%, more than 5 years 29%.
* **USD floor:** converting revenue to USD before applying the floor reduced the sample from
  494,382 to 461,882 firm-years (-6.6%) and the number of firms from 45,703 to 43,407;
  alliances in the sample changed from 51,837 to 51,563 (-0.5%).
:::

### Table 2 (all three blocks)

```{r}
#| label: table2
sdc_counts  <- readRDS(file.path(path, "sdc_counts.rds"))
link_counts <- readRDS(file.path(path, "link_counts.rds"))

table2 <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(block = "Step 1: SDC alliances (number of alliances)",
             description = c("All alliances in the SDC extract",
                             "Completed or signed, exactly two participants"),
             number = c(sdc_counts$all_alliances, sdc_counts$kept_alliances)),
  data.table(block = "Step 2: Compustat firm-years",
             description = c("All Compustat firm-years, 1988-2024",
                             "After excluding financial firms (SIC 60-69), utilities (SIC 49) & undefined industries (SIC 99)",
                             "After requiring revenue of at least USD 10 million in t-1",
                             "Analysis sample: firm-years 1990-2021 with all required variables"),
             number = c(n[[1]], n[[3]], n[[4]], n[[5]])),
  data.table(block = "Step 3: Linking alliances to Compustat firms (participants / alliance-firm obs.)",
             description = c("Participant records of the alliances in Step 1 (two per alliance)",
                             "After matching to a Compustat firm",
                             "After removing affiliated firms & requiring SIC codes for both partners",
                             "Analysis sample: alliance-firm observations 1990-2021"),
             number = c(link_counts$participants, link_counts$matched,
                        link_counts$final, sum(d$n_alliances)))))

fwrite(table2, file.path(path, "table2_sample_construction.csv"))
knitr::kable(table2, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## 4. Winsorisation within the analysis sample

Percentiles are computed **after** the sample is fixed, on the 461,882
firm-years that enter the regressions. Winsorised variables:

| Variable | Raw | Winsorised |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue growth t to t+3 (dependent variable) | `growth_f3` | `growth_f3_w` |
| Revenue growth t to t+1 (robustness R4) | `growth_f1` | `growth_f1_w` |
| Past growth (t-2 to t-1) | `growth_l1` | `growth_l1_w` |
| ROA | `roa` | `roa_w` |
| Leverage | `leverage` | `leverage_w` |

Alliance counts are not winsorised (they enter as `log(1 + count)`), and neither
is size (`ln_at_usd`).

```{r}
#| label: winsorise
wins <- function(x, p = 0.01) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(p, 1 - p), na.rm = TRUE)
  pmin(pmax(x, q[1]), q[2])
}

to_wins <- c(growth_f3 = "growth_f3_w", growth_f1 = "growth_f1_w",
             growth_l1 = "growth_l1_w", roa = "roa_w", leverage = "leverage_w")
for (v in names(to_wins)) d[, (to_wins[[v]]) := wins(get(v))]

# Diagnostics: where are the cut-offs, how many observations are capped?
wins_diag <- rbindlist(lapply(names(to_wins), function(v) {
  x <- d[[v]]
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  data.table(variable      = v,
             raw_min       = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
             p01           = q[[1]],
             p99           = q[[2]],
             raw_max       = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
             share_capped  = mean(x < q[[1]] | x > q[[2]], na.rm = TRUE))
}))
num_cols <- setdiff(names(wins_diag), "variable")
wins_diag[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, round, 4), .SDcols = num_cols]
knitr::kable(wins_diag, caption = "Winsorisation at the 1st and 99th percentile of the analysis sample")
fwrite(wins_diag, file.path(path, "table_winsorisation.csv"))

# Checks: same sample size as before, no missing values in the regression variables
stopifnot(!anyNA(d[, .(growth_f3_w, growth_l1_w, roa_w, leverage_w, ln_at_usd)]))
nrow(d)   # should still be 461,882
```
